children: Hungary's central bank delivered its third successive quarter-point rate cut to 5.5% in a unanimous decision last month, the minutes of its August 25 policy meeting showed on Wednesday.
"The decision makers agreed that the decision would be made on the future path of the base rate based on the September Inflation Report," the Monetary Council said.
The next rate-setting meeting is due on September 22.
